Title: Sacrorum conciliorum nova et amplissima collectio ... quae Joannes Dominicus Mansi archiepiscopus Lucensis evulgavit. Tomus vigesimus sextus, ab anno MCCCXLIV usque ad annum MCCCCIX
Creator: Giovanni Domenico Mansi (ed.), after Philippe Labbe, Gabriel Cossart and Nicolas Coleti; councils of the Latin West from 1344 to 1409 and the Constantinopolitan synods of 1347 and the 1350s as Mansi prints them
Publisher: Facsimile reproduction for H. Welter, Paris, 1901 ('Editio iterata ad Editionis principis exemplum ab Huberto Welter ... Parisiis M.D.CCCCI', file line 125), of the Venice edition of Antonio Zatta, 1784
Publication Date: 1901
Rights: Public Domain
Rights basis: the facsimile's imprint reads 'M.D.CCCCI' (1901) at file line 125 of the OCR and the original edition is 'Venetiis MDCCLXXXIV' (1784); host record: date 1784, volume 26, no rights field.
Language: lat (Latin)
Source: Internet Archive item sacrorumconcilio0026joan (archive.org/details/sacrorumconcilio0026joan), full-text file sacrorumconcilio0026joan_djvu.txt, fetched directly by the Library thread, October 2026.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; the OCR text follows it unchanged. Nothing was stripped, normalised, corrected, re-spaced or retyped (the long s glyph occurs 0 times and was left as found). The file is 3781889 bytes, 3767449 characters and 122103 lines. OCR quality sampled at the title pages and at about 5%, 50% and 95% of the file (lines 6105, 61051 and 115997): Latin readable with long s read as f; Greek columns garbled into Latin letters; the Latin of the tomos at about file lines 12040-12500 is the usable witness.
Content note: Mansi tomus 26. The file's own index lists, among the councils of the Latin West (Noyon 1344 to Pisa and beyond), 'Constantinopolitana Pseudo-Synodus' (1347, index p. 105) and, under the year 1359 in Mansi's reckoning, the Tomos against Barlaam, Akindynos and their followers, printed in Greek with Latin in parallel columns, with Mansi's notes citing Kantakouzenos and Gregoras. Mansi's label 'Pseudo-Synodus' is the Latin editor's view of the Palamite synods, not the synods' own. The Greek columns are rendered by the OCR in Latin letters and symbols and are not usable; the Latin is. The rest of the volume is the Western councils of the Avignon period.
